title: CPII 기업 비교 시뮬레이터 — 공개 재현용 v2 (2026-10-27)
publication_method: Separate native Google Sheets import of the delivered XLSX; original workbook retained unchanged.

github_crosslinks.replication_instruction: Use the frozen v1.0.0 release and record the repository commit and changes to simulator inputs; distinguish the current main branch from the release snapshot.

access.verified_by: Google Drive permission metadata and Google Sheets sharing UI
access.editing_instructions: 파일 → 사본 만들기에서 개인 사본을 만든 뒤 입력값을 변경한다.

native_conversion.visual_check: All 14 populated tabs inspected at 100% zoom; both comparison charts inspected. Wide tables use horizontal scrolling.
native_conversion.presentation_adjustment: Contribution chart moved below frozen heading to K4 and resized to 1048x300 pixels to prevent overlap with the second chart; source ranges and calculations unchanged.

replication_scope: The four default companies and registered benchmark are synthetic examples for reproducing the simulator, not empirical Melon or Spotify estimates.
Actual-company analysis requires matched benchmark registration, input data, feature-level provenance and workbook regeneration described in the user guide.
The 06_SENSITIVITY tab compares four methodological specifications. Input-range uncertainty is evaluated separately with the Python --feature-ranges workflow.
The public Sheet is a live convenience copy. The GitHub XLSX, code, data and publication metadata provide the versioned replication record.
